findings.evidence: <input id="family-input" name="family_name" type="text" autocomplete="family-name" autocorrect="off" spellcheck="false" required="">
findings.fix: Collect the name in one place only. Either keep the Full name field and remove First name and Last name, or replace Full name with separate first and last name fields.
